problem.title: PyCharm option Jupyter: Notebook File Root (Set the root directory for Jupyter Notebooks) missing
problem.description: I'm looking for the PyCharm equivalent of this option in VS Code: Jupyter: Notebook File Root Set the root directory for Jupyter Notebooks I usually set it to ${workspaceFolder} instead of the folder in which the .ipynb is. I can't find how to do it in PyCharm. I am not allowed to use os.chdir() or %cd blabla
